# Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative float")

    # Validate input matrices
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a floating-point array")
        if np.any(np.isnan(arr)) or np.any(np.isinf(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    # Check shape consistency
    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    # Compute per-candidate losses (sum of log probabilities) and improvement delta
    sum_with = np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    sum_call = np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    sum_no = np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)
    delta = 2 * sum_with - sum_call - sum_no

    keep = delta > tau_filter
    margins = delta.astype(np.float64)
    return keep, margins
